title: Chapter 12 The Prototype Of The City
content:
Chapter 12 The Prototype Of The City

Just when the two tribes of the Monra tribe and the Aysen tribe rebelled, what was our protagonist doing at this time?

Zhong Yu was on the hillside next to the refugee camp at this time, climbing up and looking into the distance, staring silently at the hillside not far away.

Those refugees were organized by Wang Daniu, cut down trees, and then transported them to the hillside not far away, and built houses one after another. This is their future residence, so those refugees did it with extra effort and dedication.

Looking down from the hillside, everyone looks like ants. You come and go to build their nests. It is a busy scene. Zhong Yu sees this scene, and his thoughts slowly float in his heart.

With the addition of this batch of refugees, the heritage of the territory was gradually strengthened, and the foundation of his own was gradually consolidated. Next, as long as you don't rush for quick success, slowly develop, and make a fortune in a muffled voice, the moment when you show your fangs, will also be the time when this hundreds of miles of plain is shocked.

Li Dazhuang used to be an honest peasant, with his face facing the loess and his back to the sky, he shoveled food in the ground every day, and then handed over the food he collected every year to those nobles for land rent, and then paid taxes to the court, so he worked hard every year. In the end, only 10% or 20% of the food that I planted is my own. I have to go to the mountains and the woods to dig some wild vegetables and put them on my stomach.

After that, there was a flood in your hometown. Your house and land could not be paid for this year's rent. Is it because the master pressed it again? The imperial court also came to force taxes. They took away all the valuable things in the family, even Li Dazhuang's The eleven or twelve-year-old daughter was also taken away by them, saying it was a debt repayment.

In this way, Li Dazhuang, whose family was ruined, became an honorable refugee. Every day, he was displaced, lived a life without a meal, and had a day without a meal.

In this way, three years have passed in a hurry, watching the surrounding companions continue to fall, and he is not allowed to join, from the north to the south, from the south to the west, and then back to the hometown, only to find that the thing is a human being. No.

There are broken walls and ruins everywhere in the hometown, and there are no people in the hundred miles. It is said that there was a battle here before, and those who lost the battle, the remnants of the defeated generals, turned into some soldiers and bandits, and ravaged the place.

There are soldiers and bandits everywhere, killing people like hemp, grabbing everything they see, killing everything they see, and rolling the head of a person who was directly killed here.

Those who survived all hid in the mountains and in the woods, lingering on, digging some wild vegetables every day to make ends meet.

Li Dazhuang also went to the mountains to hang out for a while, and found that those hungry people lived worse than him, with yellow faces and thin muscles, and his whole body was like a skin and bones.

In this way, when there were fewer and fewer wild animals on the mountain, and the villagers even began to hunt each other for food, Li Dazhuang left the place and began to find a new way of life.

In this way, Li Dazhuang started his wandering again. Not long after he left his hometown, he came to this place. He just slept so much, why did he come to this place?

Li Dazhuang's somewhat poor and incapable brain can't figure out this problem, so don't think about it. Li Dazhuang began to live a life here with peace of mind.

After all, although the lords here look fierce, compared to those who smile at people, they look kind on the surface, but in their hearts, they look down on people's faces, and they don't eat bones. , I was sold by them one day, I don't know, it's much better!

Also, although Zhong Yu was a bit ruthless towards them, he rudely treated them as an army, centralized them together, managed them in a unified way, worked in a unified way, and distributed them in a unified way.

It seems that there is no freedom, but at least they can eat enough, live in a house to shelter from the rain, and wear clothes that are really warm. Such a day is not much worse than a peaceful and prosperous world, right?

Compared with those who have been wandering for so many days, they still can't eat a full meal, and they have to worry about the soldiers and bandits on the road, and the homeless people who are starving and will kill and eat themselves.

In the end, he stared to death on the road in fear. Those companions were much better. How should I report the kindness of the lord!

Let go of Li Dazhuang's thoughts and think that in troubled times, such little people often suffer the same way, who would care?

After a few days of hectic work, a house has been built in the south of the city. There are about 1,000 houses. They are orderly and row upon row. Obviously, this residential area is planned very neatly and beautifully. good feeling.

This is for the future, that expanded population, now that there is enough capacity, it is still ready at one time.

There is nothing wrong with the south of the city, it is the south of the city. Zhong Yu divided this area into five areas, east, west, south, north, middle.

The north of the city is where officials and their families live, and the east of the city is the commercial street, where future transactions will be conducted.

In the west of the city, that is where the wealthy and those with unique skills live.

The south of the city is a place where a group of civilians live.

As for the city center, it is the local government office where Zhong Yu lives now. It is where all the offices and buildings of the government office are located. It will be the center of the entire city, controlling the hub within a hundred miles.

The whole city, according to Zhong Yu's plan, will consist of two carriages running side by side from the east of the city to the west of the city, and from the south to the north of the city, with two carriages passing side by side. Just, the crossroads formed.

Finally, it reaches the center of the city, which is Zhong Yu's mansion, where the government office is located. At the same time, it also divides the entire city into five parts, east, west, north, south, center.

In Zhong Yu's plan, the entire city, the economic center and the political center within a hundred miles, will accommodate a population of about 8,000 to 10,000.

With the completion of the residential building, Zhong Yu asked Wang Dazhuang to organize those refugees and start a new round of construction.

The new construction will mainly live in the north of the city, where the officials live, and the commercial and wealthy residential areas in the east and west of the city. There is no need to build it so quickly, because now, there is no unity around Zhong Lin. The economy in the territory is temporarily unavailable, so it can be left to build slowly in the future.

In this way, when those refugees were undergoing large-scale development, Zhong Yu secretly gathered all the soldiers, gave lectures, mobilized before the war, and specially mobilized them to prepare them for the possible battle at any time.

And these two places are more than ten kilometers away from Zhongyu New City. Denier's tribe and Anderson's tribe also started pre-war mobilization, and they were constantly mobilizing tribesmen from all over the world to distribute weapons that had been accumulated for decades. From time to time, the two gathered their tribesmen, stood on the high sacrificial platform, preached something loudly, and constantly invited the wizards of their tribe to sacrifice to the ancestors and gods.

The fog of war was slowly lifted, and it was clearly visible that a war that would determine the hegemony of the surrounding twenty miles was about to begin. Who would be the victor who had the last laugh!
